description_en: Calls the DeleteTopic operation to delete a topic
description_zh: 调用 DeleteTopic 删除 Topic
kebab_example: aliyun alikafka delete-topic --instance-id alikafka_post-cn-mp91a44k0000 --topic Kafkatest --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2018-10-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteTopic

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID.

You can call GetInstanceList (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/94533.html?spm=a2c4g.11186623.2.14.539f69b1wPqd3v#concept-94533-zh) to obtain the instance ID

parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the topic.

The name can contain only letters, digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-).
The name must be 3 to 64 characters in length. Names longer than 64 characters are automatically truncated.
The name cannot be modified after the topic is created
parameters.help_zh:
Topic 的名称。

只能包含字母、数字、下划线（_）和短横线（-）。
长度为 3-64 个字符，多于 64 个字符将被自动截取。
一旦创建后不能再修改
